checks.title: Validate voice settings navigation
checks.instructions: After automated QA passes, open Voix and traverse Architecture, Conversation, Tours & interruptions, Modèles, Audio, Avancé and Diagnostic by click and keyboard arrows/Home/End. Confirm inactive stack values remain visible, VAD dependencies react to turn mode, wake_toggle appears only under Tours, failed or empty device discovery can retry and disables testing without both sides, provider model selects hydrate without resetting the three catalog roles' search/compare state, and Diagnostic clearly separates effective and historical stacks without duplicate status blocks.
checks.expected: All seven backend categories remain understandable and reachable without duplicated controls; expert diagnostics and unavailable model evidence stay explicit.

execution.evidence: Real CUA walkthrough on isolated localhost runtime: all seven tabs, keyboard focus, catalog role state, audio discovery, save/reopen persistence, 390x844 and 1440x900 layouts, and an empty browser console were verified. No microphone test was run.
